description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moragaswewa, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120101
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
